SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS value, category_name AS label FROM cps_problem_category WHERE enabled = 1 AND parent_id = COALESCE(#{parentId}, 0) ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cps_problem_category ( id, parent_id, category_level, category_name, category_code, sort_no, enabled, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{parentId}, #{categoryLevel}, #{categoryName}, #{categoryCode}, #{sortNo}, #{enabled}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE parent_id = VALUES(parent_id), category_level = VALUES(category_level), category_name = VALUES(category_name), category_code = VALUES(category_code), sort_no = VALUES(sort_no), enabled = VALUES(enabled), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
